name: Level 2 Triangle-Voxel Classification
definition: Refines triangle classification into a finer 3D voxel grid (Level 2) using precomputed Level 1 voxel mappings and triangle lists.
summary: Level 2 Triangle-Voxel Classification refines coarse Level 1 results into a finer 3D voxel grid by computing precise geometric intersections to determine inside-outside status.
